## What's new
- **PC Details: GPO dates.** The Software card now ends with **GPO System Date** and **GPO User Date**: when Group Policy last applied to the PC and to the logged-in user. Green if it applied within the last 7 days (today included), red otherwise. Hover for details.
- **PC Details: IP address colour.** Orange when the address starts with 105.195, green otherwise.
- **PC Details: network speed** is now shown in Gbits/sec.
- **Side-by-side windows.** The main window fills the right half of its screen, and PC Details opens filling the left half of the same screen. The taskbar stays visible.

## Upgrading from v5.0.4
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.1.0-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.

## Requirements
- Windows 10/11 x64, domain-joined
- RSAT Active Directory tools (for AD Console)
- PowerShell 7 recommended for Remote PS and SFC Scan (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is used as a fallback)
- Target PCs: WinRM, the `c$` admin share and WMI/RPC reachable; `AllowRemoteRPC = 1` for Send Message
